title: Pharmaceutical water system case studies | Aquemi
meta: Projects told as problem, system delivered and measured outcome, with flow in L/h, conductivity, TOC and the standard met. Filter by system and industry.
headline: Problem, system delivered, measured outcome
lead: Each case study states what the client needed, what we built and what was measured at handover. Figures come from executed FAT, SAT or qualification reports.

body: Every project page opens with a project profile: industry, location by province, system, capacity in L/h, water grade and the standard met. Then three short sections: the problem, the system we delivered and the measured outcome.
We publish client names only with written permission. Every figure is taken from a signed test report.

blocks.intro: Projects can be filtered by system, industry and province.

items.d: PW generation, WFI by distillation, WFI by membrane, Pure Steam, storage and distribution, upgrades.
Pharmaceutical, biotechnology, medical devices, contract manufacturing.

blocks.h: Placeholder case studies (outlines only, not for publication until real figures are supplied)

items.t: [Placeholder] Purified Water generation and loop for an oral solid dose plant
items.problem: An existing chemical deionization system produced PW with conductivity drift toward [value] µS/cm and needed resin regeneration every [number] days. A planned capacity increase raised peak demand to [value] L/h.
items.system: Double-pass RO with electrodeionization (EDI), [volume] L 316L storage tank, ambient loop with ozone and UV ozone destruction, [number] points of use, factory acceptance tested before shipment.
items.outcome: [Conductivity at return of loop, µS/cm @ 25 °C], [TOC, ppb], [microbial count, CFU/mL] over [number] weeks of PQ; chemical regeneration eliminated; [shutdown duration] days for tie-in.

items.t: [Placeholder] WFI by membrane for a biologics fill-finish expansion
items.problem: A new fill-finish line needed [value] L/h of WFI in a room too small for a multi-effect still, with a [energy or footprint target].
items.system: Pretreatment, double-pass RO, EDI and ultrafiltration, hot WFI storage at [temperature] °C, hot loop, continuous TOC and conductivity monitoring, design rationale written to Ph. Eur. 0169.
items.outcome: [Endotoxin result, EU/mL], [TOC, ppb], [conductivity, µS/cm @ 25 °C] at OQ; [energy use compared with distillation, kWh/m³]; FAT to SAT in [number] weeks.

items.t: [Placeholder] Pure Steam generator and loop replacement for a CDMO
items.problem: An ageing Pure Steam generator failed EN 285 non-condensable gas tests and limited autoclave availability to [value]%.
items.system: [Capacity] kg/h Pure Steam generator, condensate cooler and sample point, re-routed distribution header with trapped drop legs, replacement installed during a [number]-day shutdown.
items.outcome: [Non-condensable gases, %], [superheat, K], [dryness value] at SAT; condensate met WFI conductivity and endotoxin limits; autoclave availability restored to [value]%.
